subject: Mutual action plan + invoicing / PO timing for Clearwater Health evaluation
messages:
From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation and commercial timeline

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers and the observability. We want to align the pilot finish and the commercial onboarding so procurement can process a PO efficiently. A few questions so we can map to our fiscal calendar: 

- We expect the evaluation (pilot) to run 4 weeks starting Aug 2. Do you consider billing to start at production cutover or when we begin paid pilot?
- Procurement prefers Net60, is Redwood able to extend Net60 for the pilot/initial invoice?
- PO needs to be issued before the first invoice; will Redwood accept a statement of work + PO combo, or do you require a signed contract first?

Also looping in procurement (procurement@clearwaterhealth.com). We can share estimated volume once we lock the MAP milestones.

Thanks,
Elaine
Senior Product Manager, Clearwater Health

---
Attachments: none
From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation and commercial timeline

Hi Elaine — great to hear. Quick answers inline and I attached a draft MAP that ties milestones to commercial milestones (see Redwood_MAP_CW_v1.pdf).

- Billing start: We can offer two options: (A) Billing starts when you mark production cutover (recommended for customers who want to validate in a paid pilot), or (B) Billing begins on the first invoice after the pilot start date (Aug 2). We prefer (A) to avoid billing for evaluation-only usage.
- Payment terms: Standard is Net30. We can accommodate Net60 for the initial invoice on a one-time basis for this account, provided procurement signs the PO that references the commercial term sheet by Aug 12.
- PO/contract: We accept a PO referencing the signed commercial term sheet + the attached MAP. We do require a countersigned commercial term sheet (signature request link below) before the first committed invoice.

Key next steps attached in the MAP:
- Week 0 (Aug 2): Pilot begins — onboarding + baseline metrics due
- Week 4 (Aug 30): Pilot review & quality gate
- Week 6 (Sep 14): If gates pass, we cut over to production; billing start = production cutover date unless otherwise agreed

I attached: Redwood_MAP_CW_v1.pdf (draft MAP) and Commercial_Term_Sheet_CW.xlsx (pricing tranches).

Hannah
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_CW_v1.pdf (MAP draft), Commercial_Term_Sheet_CW.xlsx (pricing spreadsheet)
From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearwaterhealth.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 15:23:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation and commercial timeline

Thanks Hannah — a couple of clarifications from procurement: 

- Procurement will only approve Net60 on the first invoice if Redwood will accept Net30 thereafter. Can we get written confirmation of that cadence?
- PO issuance: procurement needs a named billing start date to generate a PO. If billing is contingent on production cutover, they need a target cutover date captured in the MAP (they suggested Sep 15 as a target).
- Discounts: procurement asked whether the 10% ramp discount in the spreadsheet is conditioned on committed Q3 volumes or on a 3-month ramp. Can you confirm?

Also — can you provide a sample invoice cadence (monthly in arrears vs. monthly in advance) and whether Redwood issues consolidated monthly invoices or per-tenant bills?

Best,
Elaine

From: marcus.lin@redwood.com <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 11:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation and commercial timeline

Hi Elaine — thanks for the detailed ask. Short bullets to make procurement's life easier: 

- Net terms: We confirm Redwood can do Net60 on the first invoice only (as a one-time concession). All subsequent invoices will be Net30 unless otherwise contractually amended. Please let us know if procurement needs this as a written amendment to the term sheet.
- Billing cadence: Redwood issues consolidated monthly invoices in arrears (end-of-month statement for the prior month). If you run a paid pilot that starts Aug 2 and production cutover occurs Sep 14, invoice schedule would be: 
  * Aug (pilot usage billed end of Sep invoice) — if you choose billing at pilot start; or
  * Sep (if billing starts at production cutover, first invoice will be for usage between cutover and end of Sep, issued end of Oct) — we will prorate the first invoice to the exact cutover date.
- PO & signature: Procurement can issue a PO referencing the attached term sheet and the MAP. For pricing to be held, we need PO or signed term sheet by Aug 12; otherwise pricing is subject to reevaluation.
- Discounts & ramp: The 10% discount is structured as a ramp milestone: 5% applied after hitting 50% of committed monthly throughput for two consecutive months, and additional 5% after 100% of the committed throughput is sustained for one month. We can also offer an alternate structure tied to a revenue commit if that helps.

I'll attach a short one-page summary to paste into procurement's PO system. If procurement wants a formal amendment that states Net60-first-invoice and the PO references it, we can generate that doc.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: Commercial_Term_Sheet_CW.xlsx (pricing, discount rules)
From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 21:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation and commercial timeline

Elaine / Procurement team — following up with final asks & next steps so we have everything documented in the MAP: 

1) Pricing hold and PO deadline: Redwood will hold the current commercial terms (as in Commercial_Term_Sheet_CW.xlsx) until Aug 12, 23:59 PT if we receive either (a) signed term sheet via the DocuSign link below OR (b) a PO that references the term sheet and the MAP. After Aug 12 pricing is subject to review.

2) Billing start: Default = production cutover. If Clearwater prefers billing at pilot start (Aug 2), let us know before Aug 6 so we can flag internal finance. First invoice will be consolidated and issued monthly in arrears; first invoice will be prorated to the chosen billing start date.

3) Net terms: Confirmed — one-time Net60 on the first invoice if PO references the payment cadence; subsequent invoices Net30 unless otherwise agreed and signed. We'll add this clause to the term sheet on countersignature.

4) Discounts & ramp: Discount schedule is tied to committed throughput milestones in the MAP. Marcus added the milestone language; we can switch to a simple revenue-commit instead if procurement prefers fewer moving parts.

5) Signatures & links: Please sign the term sheet here: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/abc123. If procurement will send a PO instead of signing, please reference deal CW-2026-0894 and the MAP.

Next steps:
- Elaine: confirm billing start preference (pilot start vs. production cutover) by Aug 6.
- Procurement: if issuing PO, please send to procurement@redwood.com with ref CW-2026-0894 by Aug 12.
- Redwood: we will generate amendment language re: Net60-first-invoice once PO or signed term sheet is received.

Thanks all — excited to get you started.

Hannah
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
